title: US Army manuals for CUCV (military 1984-87 Chevy/GMC K-series)
summary: Full factory-level maintenance manuals for the military version of the square-body K-series pickup and Blazer. US government works, public domain.
body: CUCV (M1008 pickup, M1009 Blazer, M1010 ambulance and others) were mostly civilian 1984-87 K-series trucks with a 6.2 diesel and 24 V electrics. Engine, transmission, transfer case, axles, brakes, steering and body procedures carry over to the civilian trucks. Search the Internet Archive for "TM 9-2320-289" (the CUCV manual series).
